verdict.rationale: Sentry documents release management through its CLI, deploy notifications, CI build notifications from Bitbucket Pipelines, and suspect commits on issues. Together these give it release and deploy tracking it can tie back to errors. The evidence never shows explicit correlation of regressions with specific releases, and configuration-change tracking is not covered; the LaunchDarkly integration sends Sentry errors into LaunchDarkly rather than tracking flag changes in Sentry. Missing for 10: documented regression-to-release correlation views, configuration or feature-flag change tracking within Sentry, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking

citations.quote: Deploy notifications and source map uploads.
Suspect commits, stack traces, and PR comments.
Automatically notify Sentry of new Bitbucket Pipelines builds.
